newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine copper smelter under study - official.
newsitem.headline: Argentine copper smelter under study - official.

text.p: Several international private firms are considering building a copper smelter in Argentina, a top government mining official said Thursday.
"There are five or six companies which are very interested in building a smelter in the near future," Under Secretary for Mining Daniel Meilan told Reuters.
He said that the companies think the copper projects under construction or being planned in Argentina could provide enough output to feed a smelter.
The Argentine government would welcome any project to add value to copper exports and bring jobs to regional economies, Meilan added.
He declined to identify the companies but said that firms from countries including Japan, the United States and Chile are examining a possible smelter.
